note_overview.label: This form is to be used by field data teams to capture data according to the PVN herbaceous vegetation protocol. Refer to the appropriate Standard Operating Procedures to guide you through the data collection process. Complete this form before leaving the plot Refrain from using *Save as Draft* and select *Send* when you have finished collecting your data. 💡 Tip To remove a selection in ODK Collect, press and hold down on the question text to *Remove response*.

field_team_specifics-selected_transport_.label: Select the the mode of transport:

field_team_specifics-selected_project_te.label: Select all the team members involved in this collection activity:

survey_begin-note_parent_labels.label: Project Name: ${project_label} Project Area: ${area_label} Survey Type: ${survey_type} Target Group: ${target_group} Replicate: ${replicate}

plot_selection-selected_plot_uuid.label: Select the Vegetation Plot. This is the transect registered in the field:
plot_selection-selected_plot_uuid.hint: If you do not see the plot you are looking for, it may mean that the plot has not been registered. See form Register, Vegetation Plots

plot_selection-quadrat_note.label: You are now ready to begin collecting quadrat observations. Note that 20 quadrats are required to submit the form.

survey_end-note_field_submission.label: To avoid data loss and mistakes, Send your completed form now. When an internet connection is available, sync to ODK Central.

survey_end-confirm_submission.label: Are you sure that the data entered is complete and correct?
survey_end-confirm_submission.hint: Select 'no' if you think you may still get new information.

survey_end-herbaceous_veg_notes.label: Provide any relevant details not captured above:

herbs_present.label: Are there any herbaceous species present?

herb_species-all_unknown_unidentifiable.label: Are ALL of the specimens either unidentifiable or missing from the list below?

herb_species-selected_herb_species_uuids.label: Select ALL of the species present:
herb_species-selected_herb_species_uuids.hint: Press and hold down on the question to *Remove response*

additional_species_present.label: Are there any species present in the quadrat that are not included in the provided species list, or that you cannot identify?
additional_species_present.hint: Includes unknowns and species missing from the list

quadrat_image.label: Take a photograph of the quadrat from above, including the entire quadrat in the field of view of the camera.
quadrat_image.hint: Avoid casting a shadow over the quadrat if possible.

location_quadrat.label: Record current location standing over the quadrat

quadrat_comment.label: Add any details that should be noted about this specific quadrat in order to properly interpret the data?

species_entry_mode.label: How do you want to record this species?
species_entry_mode.hint: Choose the option that matches the specimen in front of you.
choices: Register a new Unknown — this specimen can't be identified and hasn't been recorded yet
Reuse an unknown — already activated in this or a previous submission
Add a missing species — canonical name not in the provided list
Reuse a missing species — already activated in this or a previous submission

note_new_unknown.label: New Record: ${auto_new_unknown_label} This is the entity name. Use it consistently in all plots for the same specimen.

select_reuse_unknown.label: Select the unknown to reuse
select_reuse_unknown.hint: Lists unknowns already activated in this submission. No typing.

new_missing_canonical.label: Input the canonical species name not included in the herbaceous species list:

note_new_missing.label: Important You recorded ${new_missing_canonical} as a new missing species. It has been assigned the entity ID ${auto_new_missing_label}. If you encounter this species again in another quadrat in THIS PLOT (during this submission), you will see it listed as ${auto_new_missing_label} in the reuse picker — *not* by its canonical name. The canonical name is saved and will appear future plots after submission of this form.

select_reuse_missing.label: Select the missing species to reuse
select_reuse_missing.hint: Lists missing-species entries already activated in this submission. No typing.

macro_images-note_images.label: Take at least one close-up photograph of the herbaceous plant to capture the leaf arrangement, flowers, seeds, etc. Highly recommended for all species without an existing high-performing classifier and required if marked as unknown.
macro_images-note_images.hint: One photo required for unknowns. Max. five images

note_overview.label: This form is to be used by field data teams to establish vegetation plots that will be sampled according to the PVN herbaceous vegetation and/or woody vegetation protocol. Refer to the appropriate Standard Operating Procedures to guide you through the data collection process. Complete this form before leaving the plot. Refrain from using *Save as Draft* and select *Send* when you have finished collecting your data.

plot_selection-selected_plot_uuid.hint: Purple: primary; Blue: backup; Grey: visited

plot_selection-is_plot_viable.label: Is this plot viable?
plot_selection-is_plot_viable.hint: Reasons for plots being not viable include, but are not limited to, inaccessibility, flooding, obstruction, or unavoidable road or track interference. Midpoints can be moved no further than 25m from the prescribed location to avoid obstructions, roads or tracks.

plot_metadata-unknown_dominant_woody_spe.label: Are any of these dominant woody species not present in the woody species list?
Type the names of the dominant woody species not present in the species list as Genus species. Separate multiple species with commas.

plot_metadata-canopy_height_m.label: What is the approximate canopy height, to the nearest metre?
plot_metadata-canopy_height_m.hint: i.e. Average woody species canopy height across the entire plot, not just the nearest shrub/tree.

plot_metadata-water_present.label: Is there a water source nearby?

plot_metadata-disturbance_types.label: Are there any signs of disturbance that occurred within the last year?
